propositions: rebar-debug Phase 1 exits without recording which originating ticket introduced a defect, losing provenance needed to measure defect escape rate
The automatic blame fallback misattributes defects to file authors rather than defect introducers, and cannot detect the unmet-obligation case where a fix-site differs from cause-site

Skill documentation must mandate an attribution step in Phase 1 Stage 3 before RCA writeback that traces implicated lines through commits to recover the introducing ticket and record it via --caused-by on bug close
The attribution step must handle the fix-site-not-cause-site case using date detection and producer-side git history search to find unmet obligations and missed consumer updates
Both rebar-debug and rebar-implement skills must bootstrap worktrees via `make worktree name=<branch>` and run commands with the worktree venv on PATH to avoid pre-commit hook failures
The --caused-by flag on bug close is required even when a caused_by link was previously recorded via rebar link, to prevent derive_caused_by from adding a second guessed edge
